title: Aggregation Artifacts in Subjective Tasks Collapse Large Language Models’ Posteriors
reasoning: The paper focuses on how LLMs perform on complex subjective tasks, specifically using the Moral Foundations Corpus (MFRC) as one of its primary datasets. This corpus categorizes text into moral foundations such as care, equality, proportionality, loyalty, authority, and purity, making the evaluation of morality a core component of the research.
